name: Web Leads
tagline: Web-generated demand for financial, legal, education and consumer service brands.
description: Lead generation verticals where acquisition is driven primarily by web leads, complemented by inbound calls and live transfers for financial services, loans, debt relief, credit repair, legal, education, mortgage, real estate and business services.
intro: Some categories are shopped online first. Consumers researching a personal loan, a debt relief plan, a degree program or a mortgage complete forms, compare options and expect a fast, relevant follow-up. Altarious Global generates these web leads through performance campaigns and delivers them in real time, validated and matched to your acceptance criteria.

For buyers who also want voice contact, every web lead vertical has dedicated Inbound Call and Live Transfer products, so the same campaign infrastructure can feed your call center as well as your CRM.
highlights: Real-time lead posting to your CRM or dialer
Consent capture and documentation on every lead
Inbound call and live transfer options for every category
